checkpoint_hints: [COMMAND Allocate five N by N DP tables: long[][] dpc, int[][] dpmin, int[][] dpmin2, int[][] dpmax, and int[][] dpmax2. All elements default to zero. RESULT dp_tables]

[COMMAND For each index i from 0 to N-1 inclusive, initialize the diagonal cells: dpc[i][i] = 0, dpmin[i][i] = p[i], dpmax[i][i] = p[i], dpmin2[i][i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE, and dpmax2[i][i] = -1. RESULT diagonal_initialized]
[COMMAND For each index i from 0 to N-1 inclusive, read the next integer token from the Scanner input and assign it to p[i]. RESULT p_filled]

[COMMAND Within the outer loop over interval length d from 1 to N-1 inclusive and the inner loop over start i from 0 to N-d-1 inclusive, update dpmin[i][i+d] and dpmin2[i][i+d] for interval [i, i+d] by comparing p[i+d] with dpmin[i][i+d-1] and dpmin2[i][i+d-1]: if p[i+d] is smaller than the old minimum, the old minimum becomes the second minimum and p[i+d] becomes the minimum; otherwise if p[i+d] is smaller than the old second minimum, p[i+d] becomes the second minimum and the old minimum is kept; otherwise both old minimum and second minimum are kept. RESULT dpmin_updated]

[COMMAND Within the same loops over d and i for interval [i, i+d], update dpmax[i][i+d] and dpmax2[i][i+d] symmetrically using p[i+d] against dpmax[i][i+d-1] and dpmax2[i][i+d-1]: if p[i+d] is larger than the old maximum, the old maximum becomes the second maximum and p[i+d] becomes the maximum; otherwise if p[i+d] is larger than the old second maximum, p[i+d] becomes the second maximum and the old maximum is kept; otherwise both old maximum and second maximum are kept. RESULT dpmax_updated]

[COMMAND Within the same loops over d and i, declare long rightcost and compute it by appending p[i+d] to interval [i, i+d-1]: if p[i+d] > dpmax[i][i+d-1], then rightcost = dpc[i][i+d-1]; else if p[i+d] > dpmax2[i][i+d-1], then rightcost = dpc[i][i+d-1] + Math.min(A, B); else rightcost = dpc[i][i+d-1] + B. RESULT rightcost]
